items.name: Base
items.comment: Appearance shared by the annotation sub-lines beneath the main vocal line.

fields.name: font
fields.comment: Annotation font; the family inherits the normal-line base, while the explicit `%` size renders relative to that parent.

fields.name: style
fields.comment: Annotation state styles; colors inherit the normal-line base, while explicit dimmer opacities let the rows recede beneath it.

fields.name: language
fields.comment: Preferred BCP-47 tag for the romanization; inherits the line base when left empty.
